description: USCIS's own I-140 figures. The newest quarter's receipts, approvals, denials and pending by subtype, and the last eight quarters by category. The median and posted processing times. Approved employment-based petitions waiting for a visa number, by country and category. Each part carries its own date. Example: {}.
name: get_uscis_petitions

asOf.description: The date the data is true for, YYYY-MM-DD, when one applies.

anyOf.description: USCIS's own I-140 figures: the newest quarter by subtype and the last eight by category. Also the median and posted processing times, and approved petitions waiting for a visa number.

cells.description: Every cell USCIS printed, totals included.

category.description: The preference category, e.g. EB2, or TOTAL.

count.description: Approved employment-based petitions waiting for a visa number.

country.description: The country of chargeability, or TOTAL.

month.description: The month USCIS's count is for, as YYYY-MM.

sourceFile.description: The USCIS file the counts are from.

awaitingVisa.description: Approved employment-based petitions waiting for a visa number, by country and category, as USCIS counts them.

items.description: One category's counts in one quarter.

approved.description: Petitions USCIS approved in the quarter.

categoryLabel.description: The category in USCIS's own words.

denied.description: Petitions USCIS denied in the quarter.

pending.description: Petitions pending at the quarter's end.

received.description: Petitions USCIS received in the quarter.

byQuarter.description: The newest eight quarters USCIS reported, oldest first, by category.

anyOf.description: USCIS's newest quarterly median processing time for the form.

fiscalYear.description: The federal fiscal year of the quarter.

months.description: USCIS's median processing time, in months.

quarterEnd.description: The last day of that quarter, as YYYY-MM-DD.

title.description: The row of USCIS's table the median is from.

anyOf.description: The form's times as posted on USCIS's processing times page.

postedOn.description: The day USCIS posted these times, as YYYY-MM-DD.

rows.description: Each time USCIS posts for the form.

items.description: One time USCIS posts for the form.

asPrinted.description: The time as USCIS printed it.

inquiryFrom.description: The receipt date before which USCIS lets a case ask about itself, as posted.

months.description: USCIS's posted time in months. Null where USCIS prints a note instead.

office.description: The office code USCIS posts the time under.

subtype.description: The kind of filing, as USCIS's page names it.

sourceFile.description: The USCIS file the figures are from.

approved.description: Petitions USCIS approved in the quarter.

code.description: USCIS's code for the subtype, e.g. E21.

denied.description: Petitions USCIS denied in the quarter.

pending.description: Petitions pending at the quarter's end.

received.description: Petitions USCIS received in the quarter.

quarter.description: USCIS's newest quarter of I-140 counts, by subtype. Null when it couldn't be read.

unreadable.description: The parts of this answer that couldn't be read just now, by field name. Each is null in this answer. An empty list means every part was read.

anyOf.description: No such record. Say so; don't retry the same call.

message.description: What wasn't found and what to try, in a sentence.

data.description: The answer, or found: false when no record matched.

page.description: The page on permtracker.app that shows the same thing. Cite it.

title: Get USCIS's I-140 figures
